newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Agie Charmilles says 97 dividend possible.
newsitem.headline: Agie Charmilles says 97 dividend possible.

text.p: Agie Charmilles Holding AG said it expected to be able to pay a dividend on 1997 results if shareholders approve management's plan to use reserves to cover a loss carried forward.

"At the annual general meeting on April 9, 1997, the board of directors will propose that the loss carried forward be netted with the free reserves. This will ensure that the Agie Charmilles group's capability to pay dividends will be restored for the current business year," it said in a statement.

"The board of directors is also confident that the positive development registered to date will also continue during 1997," it said. Order inflow rose 19 percent in the first two months of of the year, company officials said.
Agie Charmilles is the world's leading provider of spark-erosion machinery.
